caption:
Arriving at 8:05 on SAT day? The doors already closed.

Test centers open at 7:45 a.m. and doors close at 8:00 a.m. Testing starts around 8:15–8:30, but the door time is your deadline.

Send this to the friend who's always late.
tiktok_caption: SAT doors close at 8:00 a.m. Be there at 7:45.

youtube.title: What Time Should You Arrive for the SAT?
youtube.description: SAT test centers open at 7:45 a.m. and doors close at 8:00 a.m., so plan to arrive when the doors open.
